```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
source("tracks/first-draft-may2026/code/common_first_draft.R")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DBI)
  library(duckdb)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

save_tables  <- TRUE
save_figures <- TRUE

yr_anchor   <- 2024L
yr_lookback <- 10L
yr_new_min  <- yr_anchor - yr_lookback + 1L
min_total_branches <- 100L  # universal floor across all size buckets

sod_duckdb_path   <- "C:/empirical-data-construction/sod/sod.duckdb"
ffiec_duckdb_path <- "C:/empirical-data-construction/call-reports-FFIEC/call-reports-ffiec.duckdb"
```

```{r sod-vintage}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = sod_duckdb_path, read_only = TRUE)
uninumbr_first <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT UNINUMBR, MIN(YEAR) AS first_yr
  FROM sod
  WHERE UNINUMBR IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY UNINUMBR
"))
sod_2024 <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
  SELECT RSSDID, UNINUMBR, ASSET FROM sod
  WHERE YEAR = %d AND RSSDID IS NOT NULL AND UNINUMBR IS NOT NULL
", yr_anchor)))
banks_at_start <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
  SELECT DISTINCT RSSDID FROM sod WHERE YEAR = %d AND RSSDID IS NOT NULL
", yr_new_min - 1L)))

# Bank-year branch counts over 2014-2024 (used for productivity ratios).
sod_by <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
  SELECT RSSDID, YEAR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS n_branches
  FROM sod
  WHERE YEAR BETWEEN %d AND %d AND RSSDID IS NOT NULL AND UNINUMBR IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY RSSDID, YEAR
", yr_new_min - 1L, yr_anchor)))
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

sod_2024[,        RSSDID := as.character(RSSDID)]
banks_at_start[,  RSSDID := as.character(RSSDID)]
sod_by[,          RSSDID := as.character(RSSDID)]
sod_2024 <- merge(sod_2024, uninumbr_first, by = "UNINUMBR", all.x = TRUE)
sod_2024[, is_new_b := as.integer(first_yr >= yr_new_min)]
```

```{r bank-level-stock}
bank_lvl <- sod_2024[, .(
  n_total_2024_b  = .N,
  n_new_b         = sum(is_new_b, na.rm = TRUE),
  asset_thousands = max(as.numeric(ASSET), na.rm = TRUE)
), by = RSSDID]
bank_lvl[, new_share_b      := n_new_b / pmax(n_total_2024_b, 1)]
bank_lvl[, bank_assets      := asset_thousands * 1000]
bank_lvl[, mean_assets_b_bn := bank_assets / 1e9]
bank_lvl[, size_bucket      := assign_bucket(bank_assets)]

bank_lvl <- bank_lvl[!is.na(size_bucket) &
                     n_total_2024_b >= min_total_branches &
                     RSSDID %in% banks_at_start$RSSDID]
keep_ids <- unique(bank_lvl$RSSDID)
cat("Banks per bucket (>=", min_total_branches, "branches in 2024):\n")
print(bank_lvl[, .N, by = size_bucket])

# 2014-2024 net branch growth at the bank level.
br_pair <- merge(
  sod_by[yr == yr_new_min - 1L, .(RSSDID, n_2014 = n_branches)],
  sod_by[yr == yr_anchor,        .(RSSDID, n_2024 = n_branches)],
  by = "RSSDID")
br_pair[, branches_cagr := (n_2024 / pmax(n_2014, 1))^(1 / (yr_anchor - (yr_new_min - 1L))) - 1]
br_pair[, branches_net_change := n_2024 - n_2014]
```

```{r call-reports}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = ffiec_duckdb_path, read_only = TRUE)
bs_sql <- sprintf("
  SELECT idrssd, activity_year AS yr,
         assets, qtr_avg_assets, deposits,
         cash, securities, htmsec_ac, afssec_fv,
         ln_tot, ln_re, ln_ci, ln_cons, ln_cc, ln_agr, ln_lease,
         npl_tot, llres,
         trading_assets, intangibles, goodwill, msa, oreo,
         demand_deposits, transaction_dep, mmda, saving_dep,
         td_small, td_mid, td_large, brokered_dep,
         dom_deposit_ib, dom_deposit_nib,
         borrowings, sub_debt, equity, retained_earnings, aoci
  FROM bs_panel
  WHERE activity_quarter = 4
    AND activity_year BETWEEN %d AND %d
    AND assets > 0
", yr_new_min - 1L, yr_anchor)
bs <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, bs_sql))

is_sql <- sprintf("
  SELECT idrssd, activity_year AS yr,
         ytdint_inc, ytdint_exp, ytdint_inc_net,
         ytdnonint_inc, ytdnonint_exp, ytdllprov,
         ytdnetinc,
         ytdfiduc_inc, ytdsvc_charges, ytdtradrev_inc,
         ytdsalaries, ytdprem_exp, ytdoth_nonint_exp,
         ytdchargeoffs, ytdrecoveries,
         ytdgain_afs, ytdgain_htm,
         num_employees
  FROM is_panel
  WHERE activity_quarter = 4
    AND activity_year BETWEEN %d AND %d
", yr_new_min - 1L, yr_anchor)
is_ <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, is_sql))

# Corrected uninsured fraction.
unins_raw <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
  SELECT bs.idrssd, bs.activity_year AS yr,
         bs.deposits AS dep_total,
         TRY_CAST(rco.RCONF049 AS DOUBLE) AS unins
  FROM bs_panel bs
  LEFT JOIN schedule_rco rco
    ON bs.idrssd = rco.IDRSSD
   AND bs.activity_year = rco.activity_year
   AND bs.activity_quarter = rco.activity_quarter
  WHERE bs.activity_quarter = 4
    AND bs.activity_year BETWEEN %d AND %d
    AND bs.deposits > 0
", yr_new_min - 1L, yr_anchor)))
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

bs[,        idrssd := as.character(idrssd)]
is_[,       idrssd := as.character(idrssd)]
unins_raw[, idrssd := as.character(idrssd)]
unins_raw[, unins_frac := pmin(unins / pmax(dep_total, 1), 1)]

cr <- merge(bs, is_, by = c("idrssd", "yr"), all.x = TRUE)
cr <- merge(cr, unins_raw[, .(idrssd, yr, unins_frac)],
            by = c("idrssd", "yr"), all.x = TRUE)
cr <- merge(cr, sod_by, by.x = c("idrssd", "yr"), by.y = c("RSSDID", "yr"),
            all.x = TRUE)
setnames(cr, "idrssd", "RSSDID")
cr <- cr[RSSDID %in% keep_ids]
```

```{r ratios}
cr[, denom_assets := pmax(assets, 1)]
cr[, denom_qavg   := pmax(qtr_avg_assets, assets, 1)]
cr[, denom_loans  := pmax(ln_tot, 1)]
cr[, denom_dep    := pmax(deposits, 1)]
cr[, denom_sec    := pmax(securities, 1)]
cr[, denom_npl    := pmax(npl_tot,    1)]
cr[, denom_branch := pmax(n_branches, 1)]
cr[, revenue      := ytdint_inc_net + ytdnonint_inc]

# Block 1: cost / efficiency
cr[, eff_ratio          := ifelse(revenue > 0, ytdnonint_exp / revenue, NA_real_)]
cr[, nie_assets         := ytdnonint_exp / denom_assets]
cr[, int_exp_assets     := ytdint_exp    / denom_assets]
cr[, salaries_assets    := ytdsalaries   / denom_assets]
cr[, premises_assets    := ytdprem_exp   / denom_assets]
cr[, oth_nie_assets     := ytdoth_nonint_exp / denom_assets]
cr[, assets_per_emp_mn  := ifelse(num_employees > 0,
                                  assets / num_employees / 1e3, NA_real_)]
cr[, log_employees      := ifelse(num_employees > 0, log(num_employees), NA_real_)]
cr[, avg_comp_k         := ifelse(num_employees > 0,
                                  ytdsalaries / num_employees, NA_real_)]
cr[, employees_per_branch := ifelse(n_branches > 0 & num_employees > 0,
                                    num_employees / n_branches, NA_real_)]

# Block 2: fee / cross-sell
cr[, nonint_inc_revenue := ifelse(revenue > 0, ytdnonint_inc / revenue, NA_real_)]
cr[, fiduc_inc_revenue  := ifelse(revenue > 0, ytdfiduc_inc  / revenue, NA_real_)]
cr[, svc_chg_revenue    := ifelse(revenue > 0, ytdsvc_charges / revenue, NA_real_)]
cr[, trading_rev_revenue:= ifelse(revenue > 0, ytdtradrev_inc / revenue, NA_real_)]
cr[, fee_assets         := ytdnonint_inc / denom_assets]
cr[, card_share_loans   := ln_cc / denom_loans]
cr[, msa_assets         := msa     / denom_assets]
cr[, intang_assets      := (intangibles + goodwill) / denom_assets]
cr[, goodwill_assets    := goodwill     / denom_assets]

# Block 3: loan-book + credit quality
loan_cats <- c("ln_re", "ln_ci", "ln_cons", "ln_cc", "ln_agr", "ln_lease")
cr[, (paste0("s_", loan_cats)) := lapply(.SD, function(x) x / denom_loans),
   .SDcols = loan_cats]
cr[, loan_hhi          := s_ln_re^2 + s_ln_ci^2 + s_ln_cons^2 +
                          s_ln_cc^2 + s_ln_agr^2 + s_ln_lease^2]
cr[, ci_share_loans    := ln_ci    / denom_loans]
cr[, re_share_loans    := ln_re    / denom_loans]
cr[, cons_share_loans  := ln_cons  / denom_loans]
cr[, agr_share_loans   := ln_agr   / denom_loans]
cr[, lease_share_loans := ln_lease / denom_loans]
cr[, npl_loans         := npl_tot  / denom_loans]
cr[, llres_loans       := llres    / denom_loans]
cr[, llres_npl_cov     := llres / denom_npl]
cr[, oreo_loans        := oreo     / denom_loans]
cr[, net_co_loans      := (ytdchargeoffs - ytdrecoveries) / denom_loans]
cr[, llprov_assets     := ytdllprov / denom_assets]

# Block 4: balance-sheet character
cr[, cash_assets       := cash    / denom_assets]
cr[, sec_assets        := securities / denom_assets]
cr[, loans_assets      := ln_tot  / denom_assets]
cr[, htm_share_sec     := htmsec_ac / denom_sec]
cr[, afs_share_sec     := afssec_fv / denom_sec]
cr[, trading_assets_sh := trading_assets / denom_assets]

# Block 5: funding mix
cr[, time_dep_total    := td_small + td_mid + td_large]
cr[, dep_assets        := deposits / denom_assets]
cr[, demand_dep_share  := demand_deposits / denom_dep]
cr[, mmda_sav_share    := (mmda + saving_dep) / denom_dep]
cr[, time_dep_share    := time_dep_total / denom_dep]
cr[, brokered_dep_share:= brokered_dep / denom_dep]
cr[, nib_dep_share     := dom_deposit_nib / denom_dep]
cr[, ib_dep_share      := dom_deposit_ib  / denom_dep]
cr[, borrowings_assets := borrowings / denom_assets]
cr[, sub_debt_equity   := sub_debt / pmax(equity, 1)]

# Block 6: capital + earnings
cr[, equity_assets     := equity / denom_assets]
cr[, tangible_eq_assets := (equity - intangibles - goodwill) /
                           pmax(assets - intangibles - goodwill, 1)]
cr[, aoci_equity       := aoci / pmax(equity, 1)]
cr[, retained_earnings_assets := retained_earnings / denom_assets]
cr[, ppnr_assets       := (revenue - ytdnonint_exp) / denom_assets]
cr[, nii_assets        := ytdint_inc_net / denom_assets]
cr[, sec_gains_assets  := (ytdgain_afs + ytdgain_htm) / denom_assets]

# Block 7: productivity per branch
cr[, dep_per_branch_mn   := deposits / denom_branch / 1e3]
cr[, assets_per_branch_mn:= assets   / denom_branch / 1e3]
cr[, loans_per_branch_mn := ln_tot   / denom_branch / 1e3]

# Context: profitability
cr[, roa               := ytdnetinc      / denom_qavg]
cr[, nim               := ytdint_inc_net / denom_qavg]

ratio_cols <- c(
  # Block 1
  "eff_ratio", "nie_assets", "int_exp_assets",
  "salaries_assets", "premises_assets", "oth_nie_assets",
  "assets_per_emp_mn", "log_employees", "avg_comp_k", "employees_per_branch",
  # Block 2
  "nonint_inc_revenue", "fiduc_inc_revenue", "svc_chg_revenue",
  "trading_rev_revenue", "fee_assets", "card_share_loans",
  "msa_assets", "intang_assets", "goodwill_assets",
  # Block 3
  "loan_hhi", "ci_share_loans", "re_share_loans",
  "cons_share_loans", "agr_share_loans", "lease_share_loans",
  "npl_loans", "llres_loans", "llres_npl_cov", "oreo_loans",
  "net_co_loans", "llprov_assets",
  # Block 4
  "cash_assets", "sec_assets", "loans_assets",
  "htm_share_sec", "afs_share_sec", "trading_assets_sh",
  # Block 5
  "dep_assets", "demand_dep_share", "mmda_sav_share",
  "time_dep_share", "brokered_dep_share",
  "nib_dep_share", "ib_dep_share",
  "borrowings_assets", "sub_debt_equity",
  # Block 6
  "equity_assets", "tangible_eq_assets", "aoci_equity",
  "retained_earnings_assets",
  "ppnr_assets", "nii_assets", "sec_gains_assets",
  # Block 7
  "dep_per_branch_mn", "assets_per_branch_mn", "loans_per_branch_mn",
  # Context
  "roa", "nim")

cr_b <- cr[, lapply(.SD, function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
           by = RSSDID, .SDcols = ratio_cols]

# CAGRs and growth volatility 2014-2024.
yoy <- cr[order(RSSDID, yr),
          .(yr,
            asset_yoy = log(assets)   - shift(log(assets)),
            loan_yoy  = log(pmax(ln_tot,    1)) - shift(log(pmax(ln_tot,    1))),
            dep_yoy   = log(pmax(deposits, 1)) - shift(log(pmax(deposits, 1)))),
          by = RSSDID]
vol_b <- yoy[is.finite(asset_yoy),
             .(asset_growth_sd = sd(asset_yoy, na.rm = TRUE),
               loan_growth_sd  = sd(loan_yoy,  na.rm = TRUE),
               dep_growth_sd   = sd(dep_yoy,   na.rm = TRUE)),
             by = RSSDID]

cagr <- merge(
  cr[yr == yr_new_min - 1L, .(RSSDID, asset_2014 = assets,
                              loan_2014 = ln_tot, dep_2014 = deposits)],
  cr[yr == yr_anchor,       .(RSSDID, asset_2024 = assets,
                              loan_2024 = ln_tot, dep_2024 = deposits)],
  by = "RSSDID")
cagr[, asset_cagr := (asset_2024 / asset_2014)^(1 / (yr_anchor - (yr_new_min - 1L))) - 1]
cagr[, loan_cagr  := (loan_2024  / pmax(loan_2014, 1))^(1 / (yr_anchor - (yr_new_min - 1L))) - 1]
cagr[, dep_cagr   := (dep_2024   / pmax(dep_2014,  1))^(1 / (yr_anchor - (yr_new_min - 1L))) - 1]

cr_b <- merge(cr_b, cagr[, .(RSSDID, asset_cagr, loan_cagr, dep_cagr)],
              by = "RSSDID", all.x = TRUE)
cr_b <- merge(cr_b, vol_b, by = "RSSDID", all.x = TRUE)
cr_b <- merge(cr_b, br_pair[, .(RSSDID, branches_cagr, branches_net_change)],
              by = "RSSDID", all.x = TRUE)
```

```{r master-breadth}
master_parts <- Sys.glob(file.path(data_dir, "master_bank_zip_year_*_part*.rds"))
dates_m      <- regmatches(master_parts, regexpr("\\d{8}", master_parts))
master_parts <- sort(master_parts[dates_m == max(dates_m)])
mst <- rbindlist(lapply(master_parts, readRDS))
mst[, RSSDID := as.character(RSSDID)]

br <- mst[yr >= yr_new_min - 1L & yr <= yr_anchor & RSSDID %in% keep_ids,
          .(n_zips_op   = sum(n_branches_bzt > 0L,            na.rm = TRUE),
            n_zips_mort = sum(mortgage_presence == 1L,        na.rm = TRUE),
            n_zips_cra  = sum(cra_presence      == 1L,        na.rm = TRUE),
            n_zips_mort_in_op = sum(n_branches_bzt > 0L & mortgage_presence == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_zips_cra_in_op  = sum(n_branches_bzt > 0L & cra_presence      == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)),
          by = .(RSSDID, yr)]
breadth_b <- br[, .(zips_op_avg     = mean(n_zips_op),
                    zips_mort_avg   = mean(n_zips_mort),
                    zips_cra_avg    = mean(n_zips_cra),
                    log_zips_op     = log(pmax(mean(n_zips_op),   1)),
                    log_zips_mort   = log(pmax(mean(n_zips_mort), 1)),
                    log_zips_cra    = log(pmax(mean(n_zips_cra),  1)),
                    mort_overlap    = mean(n_zips_mort_in_op / pmax(n_zips_op, 1)),
                    cra_overlap     = mean(n_zips_cra_in_op  / pmax(n_zips_op, 1)),
                    mort_breadth_ratio = mean(n_zips_mort / pmax(n_zips_op, 1)),
                    cra_breadth_ratio  = mean(n_zips_cra  / pmax(n_zips_op, 1))),
                by = RSSDID]
rm(mst); gc(verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r paper-key-measures}
beta_path <- load_latest(file.path(data_dir, "bank_zip_year_deposit_beta_*.rds"))
bb <- setDT(readRDS(beta_path))
bb[, RSSDID := as.character(RSSDID)]
beta_b <- bb[!is.na(deposit_beta) & is.finite(deposit_beta) &
             yr >= yr_new_min - 1L & yr <= yr_anchor &
             RSSDID %in% keep_ids,
             .(deposit_beta = mean(deposit_beta, na.rm = TRUE)),
             by = RSSDID]

ctrl_path <- load_latest(file.path(data_dir, "bank_year_dec_controls_*.rds"))
ctrls <- setDT(readRDS(ctrl_path))
ctrls[, id_rssd := as.character(id_rssd)]
setnames(ctrls, "id_rssd", "RSSDID")
ctrls <- merge(ctrls, unins_raw[, .(RSSDID = idrssd, yr, unins_frac)],
               by = c("RSSDID", "yr"), all.x = TRUE)
ctrls[!is.na(unins_frac), uninsured_deposits_frac := unins_frac]

ctrl_b <- ctrls[yr >= yr_new_min - 1L & yr <= yr_anchor & RSSDID %in% keep_ids,
                .(uninsured_deposits_frac = mean(uninsured_deposits_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
                  trans_accts_frac_assets = mean(trans_accts_frac_assets, na.rm = TRUE),
                  time_deposits_assets    = mean(time_deposits_assets,    na.rm = TRUE)),
                by = RSSDID]
```

```{r merge}
panel <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "RSSDID", all.x = TRUE),
                list(bank_lvl, cr_b, breadth_b, beta_b, ctrl_b))
```

```{r helpers}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || is.na(a) || !nzchar(a)) b else a

winsor_in_place <- function(d, vars, p = c(0.01, 0.99)) {
  for (v in vars) {
    x <- d[[v]]
    if (!is.numeric(x)) next
    set(d, j = v, value = winsor(x, p = p))
  }
  d
}

build_panel <- function(d, vars) {
  med <- median(d$new_share_b, na.rm = TRUE)
  d[, high_opener := as.integer(new_share_b >= med)]
  rows <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
    x_low  <- d[high_opener == 0L, get(v)]; x_low  <- x_low[is.finite(x_low)]
    x_high <- d[high_opener == 1L, get(v)]; x_high <- x_high[is.finite(x_high)]
    if (length(x_low) < 2 || length(x_high) < 2)
      return(data.table(Variable = label_lookup[v] %||% v,
                        Low="", High="", Diff="", t="",
                        N_low = format(length(x_low),  big.mark=","),
                        N_high= format(length(x_high), big.mark=",")))
    tt <- tryCatch(t.test(x_high, x_low), error = function(e) NULL)
    diff <- mean(x_high) - mean(x_low)
    pv   <- if (!is.null(tt)) tt$p.value else NA_real_
    sig  <- if (is.na(pv)) ""
            else if (pv < 0.01) "***"
            else if (pv < 0.05) "**"
            else if (pv < 0.10) "*"
            else ""
    data.table(
      Variable = label_lookup[v] %||% v,
      Low      = sprintf("%.4f", mean(x_low)),
      High     = sprintf("%.4f", mean(x_high)),
      Diff     = sprintf("%.4f%s", diff, sig),
      t        = if (!is.null(tt) && is.finite(tt$statistic))
                    sprintf("%.2f", tt$statistic) else "",
      N_low    = format(length(x_low),  big.mark=","),
      N_high   = format(length(x_high), big.mark=",")
    )
  })
  rbindlist(rows, use.names=TRUE, fill=TRUE)
}

emit_panel_blocks <- function(d, blocks, file_stem) {
  pieces <- lapply(names(blocks), function(blk) {
    list(label = blk, dt = build_panel(d, blocks[[blk]]))
  })

  md_out <- character(0)
  for (p in pieces) {
    md_out <- c(md_out,
                paste0("**", p$label, "**"), "",
                as.character(knitr::kable(p$dt, format = "pipe",
                                          row.names = FALSE,
                                          align = "lrrrrrr")),
                "")
  }
  out_md <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".md"))
  writeLines(md_out, out_md)
  cat("Wrote:", out_md, "\n")

  if (isTRUE(save_tables)) {
    header <- "\\begin{tabular}{lrrrrrr}\n\\toprule\n"
    col_names <- paste(c("Variable","Low","High","Diff","$t$",
                         "$N_{\\text{low}}$","$N_{\\text{high}}$"),
                       collapse = " & ")
    body <- ""
    for (i in seq_along(pieces)) {
      p <- pieces[[i]]
      sep_top  <- if (i == 1L) "" else "\\midrule\n"
      head_row <- sprintf("%s\\multicolumn{7}{l}{\\emph{%s}} \\\\\n\\midrule\n",
                          sep_top, p$label)
      body_lines <- apply(p$dt, 1L, function(r)
        paste(c(r[["Variable"]], r[["Low"]], r[["High"]], r[["Diff"]],
                r[["t"]], r[["N_low"]], r[["N_high"]]), collapse = " & "))
      body <- paste0(body, head_row,
                     paste(paste0(body_lines, " \\\\"), collapse = "\n"),
                     "\n")
    }
    tex <- paste0(header, col_names, " \\\\\n\\midrule\n",
                  body, "\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabular}\n")
    out_tex <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".tex"))
    writeLines(tex, out_tex); cat("Wrote:", out_tex, "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r per-bucket}
                                        "branches_net_change"))

panel_big <- copy(panel[size_bucket == "ge_100bn"])
panel_mid <- copy(panel[size_bucket == "10_100bn"])
panel_sml <- copy(panel[size_bucket == "1_10bn"])

panel_big <- winsor_in_place(panel_big, winsor_vars)
panel_mid <- winsor_in_place(panel_mid, winsor_vars)
panel_sml <- winsor_in_place(panel_sml, winsor_vars)

emit_panel_blocks(panel_big, display_blocks, "tab_franchise100_big")
emit_panel_blocks(panel_mid, display_blocks, "tab_franchise100_mid")
if (nrow(panel_sml) >= 4)
  emit_panel_blocks(panel_sml, display_blocks, "tab_franchise100_sml")
```
